label: TEST
automations: Align Motor to flight position CMD: (BUTTON AND [B1232=1]) -> A90 set R3199 := 8.0
ALT CMD Change ASL UP: BUTTON -> A79 set B1251 := 1.0
ALT CMD change ASL Down: BUTTON -> A85 set B1252 := 1.0
ALT CMD Change AGL UP: BUTTON -> A79 set B1251 := 1.0
ALT CMD change AGL Down: BUTTON -> A85 set B1252 := 1.0

label: AGL
automations: ALT AFL MODE CMD ON: (BUTTON AND [B1250=0]) -> A86 set B1250 := 1.0 || ALT AFL MODE CMD OFF: (BUTTON AND NOT [B1250=0]) -> A87 set B1250 := 0.0

label: PCS
automations: not in the AP PDI (event of that device)

label: UAV
automations: Request Onetime MSG: BUTTON -> A31 set B1249 := 1.0; A43 user timer 6
Generator enable ON: (BUTTON AND [B1705=0]) -> A67 set B1787 := 1.0 || Generator enable OFF: (BUTTON AND NOT [B1705=0]) -> A68 set B1787 := 0.0

label: NAV
automations: NAV Light Position ON: (BUTTON AND [B2199=0]) -> A36 GPIO 1 on; A38 set B2199 := 1.0 || NAV Light Position OFF: (NOT [B2199=0] AND BUTTON) -> A35 GPIO 1 off; A37 set B2199 := 0.0

label: STR
automations: STROBE Light Position ON : (BUTTON AND [B2198=0]) -> A39 GPIO 2 on; A40 set B2198 := 1.0 || STROBE Light Position OFF: (BUTTON AND NOT [B2198=0]) -> A41 GPIO 2 off; A42 set B2198 := 0.0

label: MODE
automations: LIDAR AUTO Mode ON Button: (BUTTON AND NOT [limits 73]) -> A62 set U1004 := 1.0 || LIDAR AUTO Mode OFF Button: (BUTTON AND [limits 73]) -> A63 set U1004 := 0.0

label: PWR
automations: LIDAR ON Button: (BUTTON AND NOT [limits 72]) -> A53 set U1003 := 1.0; A61 set U1004 := 0.0 || LIDAR OFF Button: (BUTTON AND [limits 72]) -> A58 set U1003 := 0.0; A61 set U1004 := 0.0

group: Panel Group / Engine panel / Engine crank (armed only)
label: Start
automations: Engine Crank: (BUTTON AND [phase in ARMED]) -> A56 set B1790 := 1.0, B1610 := 1.0

label: SET
automations: Engine Panel Throttle Control Button ON: (BUTTON AND [B1300=0]) -> A78 set B1300 := 1.0 || Engine Panel Throttle Control Button OFF: (BUTTON AND NOT [B1300=0]) -> A80 set B1300 := 0.0

label: MIN
automations: IAS CMD MODE MINIMUM: BUTTON -> A45 set U1002 := 1.0

label: CRS
automations: IAS CMD MODE NOMINAL: BUTTON -> A46 set U1002 := 0.0

label: MAX
automations: IAS CMD MODE MAXIMUM: BUTTON -> A47 set U1002 := 2.0
IAS MANUAL CHANGE UP CMD: BUTTON -> A49 set B1217 := 1.0; A48 set U1002 := 3.0
IAS MANUAL CHANGE DOWN CMD: BUTTON -> A50 set B1218 := 1.0; A48 set U1002 := 3.0

label: CALIBRATE
automations: IAS Offset calibration: (BUTTON AND [phase in INITIAL]) -> A98 set B1274 := 1.0

label: SEC EN
automations: Secondary FBX Selected ON: (BUTTON AND NOT [B1301=1]) -> A10 set B1301 := 1.0; A32 set B1304 := 0.0; A8 set B1285 := 0.0 || Secondary FBX Selected OFF: (BUTTON AND [B1301=1]) -> A13 set B1301 := 0.0; A32 set B1304 := 0.0; A8 set B1285 := 0.0

label: MOTOR DISARM
automations: Motors arm Software Enable Button to OFF: (BUTTON AND [B1247=1]) -> A25 set B1247 := 0.0 || Motors arm Software Enable Button to On: ((BUTTON AND NOT [B1247=1]) OR [phase in STANDBY/TAKE-OFF READY/ARMED/INITIAL]) -> A28 set B1247 := 1.0
Clear Sticky Errors: BUTTON -> A92 CAN tx producer 2 msg 4; A93 CAN tx producer 2 msg 5
